title: Chinese Checkers: star-shaped triangular lattice
description: Chinese Checkers uses a 121-position star-shaped board (hexagram) on a triangular lattice. Players hop pieces across the board from one triangle point to the opposite. Validates: non-rectangular board boundaries on hex/triangular grids, hop movement primitive with multi-hop chains (like checkers), 2-6 player support. The board is a hex grid with a star-shaped mask — positions exist only where the star has points. Could use a graph zone with explicit adjacency, or a hex_grid with boundary masking.
close_reason: Chinese Checkers fully playable. 121-position hexagram board via valid_cells mask, hex_6 adjacency, step/hop movement, multi-hop chains, win detection. 42 tests.
